objective: Define LSS-04 Loot Acquisition & Transfer Foundation. Govern ordinary loot acquisition from already-existing Assets in defeated-owner possessions, containers, caches and authored loose-object sources, plus explicitly authored drop outputs, using visibility-safe authorization, expected-version checks, deterministic operation identities, duplication-safe transfer intents and durable D17 owner receipts. D17 remains live Asset identity/state/ownership/location/quantity/lineage truth; MIB-03 remains version/idempotency/retry/recovery authority; MIB-13 remains market/trade/value authority. No loot quality, quantity or drop result may be inferred from opponent level, rarity, category or common sense.

MIB-03 stable operation identity, expected-version, authorization, retry/replay and owner-receipt primitives
MIB-13 trade/value authority boundary and D17-owned Asset transfer semantics

Opponent level/rarity must not generate or upgrade loot. No market/payment, scavenge opportunity or salvage extraction behavior is included.
